Count Number of Points within a Distance

In this section, we’ll count the number of point features of CHAS clinic within 1 km of another point feature (eldercare centre)

eldercare <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial",
                     layer = "ELDERCARE") %>%
  st_transform(crs = 3414)
Reading layer `ELDERCARE' from data source 
  `C:\stefanie-fel\ISSS626-GAA\In-class_Ex\In-class_Ex09\data\geospatial' 
  using driver `ESRI Shapefile'
Simple feature collection with 120 features and 19 fields
Geometry type: POINT
Dimension:     XY
Bounding box:  xmin: 14481.92 ymin: 28218.43 xmax: 41665.14 ymax: 46804.9
Projected CRS: SVY21 / Singapore TM
CHAS <- st_read("data/geospatial/CHASClinics.kml") %>%
  st_transform(crs = 3414)
Reading layer `MOH_CHAS_CLINICS' from data source 
  `C:\stefanie-fel\ISSS626-GAA\In-class_Ex\In-class_Ex09\data\geospatial\CHASClinics.kml' 
  using driver `KML'
Simple feature collection with 1193 features and 2 fields
Geometry type: POINT
Dimension:     XYZ
Bounding box:  xmin: 103.5818 ymin: 1.016264 xmax: 103.9903 ymax: 1.456037
z_range:       zmin: 0 zmax: 0
Geodetic CRS:  WGS 84
buffer_1km <- st_buffer(eldercare, 
                        dist = 1000)
tmap_mode("view")
ℹ tmap mode set to "view".
tm_shape(buffer_1km) +
  tm_polygons() +
tm_shape(CHAS) +
  tm_dots()
Registered S3 method overwritten by 'jsonify':
  method     from    
  print.json jsonlite
buffer_1km$pts_count <- lengths(
  st_intersects(buffer_1km, CHAS))

Data Cleaning and Update Attribute

eldercare <- eldercare %>%
  select(fid, ADDRESSPOS) %>%
  mutate(capacity = 100)
hexagons <- hexagons %>%
  select(fid) %>%
  mutate(demand = 100)
distmat <- ODMatrix %>%
  select(origin_id, destination_id, total_cost) %>%
  spread(destination_id, total_cost)%>%
  select(c(-c('origin_id')))
distmat_km <- as.matrix(distmat/1000)

Compute Handsen’s Accessibility

acc_Hansen <- data.frame(ac(hexagons$demand,
                            eldercare$capacity,
                            distmat_km, 
                            #d0 = 50,
                            power = 2, 
                            family = "Hansen"))

Visualize Accessibility

colnames(acc_Hansen) <- "accHansen"

acc_Hansen <- as_tibble(acc_Hansen)

hexagon_Hansen <- bind_cols(hexagons, acc_Hansen)
mapex <- st_bbox(hexagons)

tmap_mode("plot")
ℹ tmap mode set to "plot".
tm_shape(hexagon_Hansen, bbox = st_bbox(hexagons)) +
  tm_polygons(
    fill = "accHansen",
    fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(style = "quantile", n = 10),
    fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Accessibility (Hansen)"),
    border.col = "black"
  ) +
tm_shape(eldercare) +
  tm_symbols(size = 0.1) +
  tm_compass(type = "8star", size = 2) +
  tm_grid(lwd = 0.1, alpha = 0.5) +
  tm_title("Accessibility to eldercare: Hansen method",
           position = c("center", "top"),
           size = 1.2) +
  tm_legend(position = c("right", "top")) +
  tm_scalebar() +   # <— move to the very end
  tm_layout(frame = TRUE)
